message.reasoning:
The user wants me to implement the P-LIT-SELECT pattern by changing the workflow_yaml from enabled: false to enabled: true, while keeping all other values unchanged. The scenario_contract specifies the allowed_result with enabled: true.

Looking at the workflow_yaml:
```
pattern: P-LIT-SELECT
enabled: false
workers: 1
unknown_inputs: run_all
preserve_required_outputs: true
```

I need to change enabled: false to enabled: true, and keep everything else the same.

The allowed_result in scenario_contract confirms this:
```
"allowed_result": {"pattern": "P-LIT-SELECT", "enabled": true, "workers": 1, "unknown_inputs": "run_all", "preserve_required_outputs": true}
```

So I just need to return the YAML with enabled: true.
